answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Proof of unique app purchase history with store attestation flips the bet — purchases the store recorded across years on one account — and the lagoon lands on the attacker instead. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the pigment of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The nectar is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
